research_question: To extract crucial information related to catalysts from domain literature for the CO2 electrocatalytic reduction process.
data: Scientific literature on CO2 electrocatalysts and synthesis procedures.
conclusion: The work presents an open-source corpus for electrocatalytic CO2 reduction by leveraging information from domain literature using cutting-edge computer techniques.

research_question: potential of large language models for financial “nowcasting”–real-time forecasting (of the recent past) for cryptocurrency market conditions
data: minute-resolution history of a day in USD for the stocks
methods: benchmarking capabilities of five state-of-the-art decoder-only models
experimentations conducted for two passes (Pass@1 and Pass@2)
conclusion: gemini-2.5-pro emerges as a consistent leader in forecasting (except for a few assets). The stablecoins exhibit minimal deviation across all models, justifying the “nowcast strength” in low-volatility environments, although they are not able to perform well for the highly erratic assets.

research_question: To develop a new threat model for latent backdoor reinforcement attacks to exploit the unlearning and learning gaps in federated semantic communication systems, and to introduce an Agentic and Generative AI-enabled Federated Unlearning (AgGenFU) framework to address these threats.
data: The article develops a new threat model for latent backdoor reinforcement attacks to exploit the unlearning and learning gaps in federated semantic communication systems. It introduces Agentic and Generative AI-enabled Federated Unlearning (AgGenFU), a dual AI framework with an Agentic AI-enabled controller for adaptive, privacy-preserving unlearning decisions with a generative recovery mechanism to restore semantic integrity during FU. The agentic AI-enabled controller autonomously manages unlearning decisions by adjusting privacy risks against utility losses. Generative AI recovery mechanisms utilize variational autoencoders to restore both the model’s performance and semantic integrity without reintroducing previously learned compromised patterns. The research offers recommendations and architectural frameworks for secure privacy-compliant design and standardization of agentic AI-enabled semantic communication frameworks for 6G networks.
conclusion: The research proposes an Agentic and Generative AI-enabled Federated Unlearning (AgGenFU) framework to mitigate latent backdoor reinforcement attacks in federated semantic communication systems, offering architectural frameworks for secure 6G network design.

research_question: investigate the factors that affect the adoption of ChatGPT among higher education students
methods: conceptual model combining both the adoption and personal characteristics
conclusion: perceived advantage compatibility and visibility have a negative impact on ChatGPT adoption, while triability and ease of use have a positive impact.

research_question: Navigating codified, tacit and novel rules: Mapping the human-AI creativity frontier.
data: synthetic annotations of the semantic content of task descriptions in the Australian Skills Classification
conclusion: The mixed category, involving hybrid carrier configurations, predominates (86.3%), alongside limited replacement (2.7%) and AI immune (11.0%) categories. Two levels of human-AI complementarity are identified: rule types within tasks and efficiency potential when performing tasks.

research_question: How can inclusive development be sustained in the Asia-Pacific region amidst the transformation caused by Artificial Intelligence?
conclusion: The viability of AI transition depends on combining labour-market and fiscal transmission to cover adjustment costs.

research_question: how the incorporation of generative AI and AI literacy influences e-entrepreneurial intention through the psychological mechanisms of perceived desirability and feasibility
data: dataset recruited from 504 higher education students in Vietnam
conclusion: The incorporation of generative AI and AI literacy has a positive impact on desirability, feasibility, and intention, both directly and indirectly. Alignment between desirability and feasibility enhances intention, whereas misalignment reduces it. Practical recommendations emphasize the integration of AI tools and literacy training into educational programs to equip students with the skills and motivation necessary for e-entrepreneurship.

research_question: How do online users from domestic and international audiences authenticate social media influencers (SMIs) that contribute to building a destination's organic image?
data: LLM prompt engineering combined with theoretically guided human interpretations of authentication aspects (genuineness, otherizing, traditionalizing, nostalgia, and existential authenticity).
conclusion: Authentication through otherizing and existential authenticity is more prevalent among international followers, while domestic viewers use traditionalizing and nostalgia more. Destination Marketing Organizations (DMOs) can leverage these differences in perceptions in their marketing communications with respective audiences.

research_question: Comparison of the performance of GPT-3 and PaLM-2 in producing Indonesian cultural content.
data: Expert judgment method for correctness evaluation and BERTScore for fine-tuning capabilities.
conclusion: PaLM-2 produced more valid content (score of 27 points), while GPT-3 excelled in fine-tuning. GPT-3 was superior for training on new datasets/fine-tuning.

research_question: To address the challenges of predicting the employability of computer science graduates, how can a framework combining ensemble machine learning and generative AI be used to predict employability based on educational big data?
methods: based machine learning (ML) techniques (random forest, k nearest neighbor, decision tree, logistic regression)
conclusion: The LR+GMA-NN model achieves the highest accuracy at 97.846%, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art model by an efficiency gain of 4.398%.
